tips.0: The best times to post are between 6pm and 9pm on weekdays and 10am-12pm on weekends.
tips.1: Use between 5 and 15 hashtags per post. Too many hashtags can look like spam to the algorithm.
tips.2: Posting 3 to 5 times a week to the feed is the ideal pace for small stores. Consistency matters more than volume.
tips.3: Mix large (+1M), medium (100k-500k) and niche (-50k) hashtags. The combination increases your reach.
tips.4: Reply to all comments within 1 hour of posting. The algorithm favors posts with fast engagement.
tips.5: Stories should be posted every day, even when the feed takes a break. Stories keep you at the top of the list.
tips.6: Reuse posts that performed well. If a product sold a lot, create a variation of the same content 2 months later.
tips.7: The first line of the caption is decisive. It appears before "see more", make it spark curiosity or urgency.
